title: Stampede
description: 4 096 horses gallop around a valley at golden hour. The GPU steers them among neighbours found through the grid. Distance culling chooses skinned meshes near the camera and posed impostor cards farther away. Three sun cascades keep shadows sharp beside a horse and reach trees 320 m out. A horse changing gait blends along a line from walk to gallop and keeps its stride. Events count each group. The pointer frightens horses, and panic spreads through the herd. Hover to pick and name a horse, click it to ride along, or click the ground to send a thunderclap through the herd. The horse is by Quaternius (CC0). Trees and rocks are from Kay Lousberg's KayKit Forest Nature Pack (CC0).
line: 4 096 horses under sun cascades, skinned nearby and cards farther off, easing into a gallop when frightened.
hint: hover to frighten · click a horse to ride with it · click the ground for thunder · drag to orbit
